title: EPAM FastAPI Architecture
description: FastAPI routing, dependency injection, Pydantic validation, middleware, JWT auth, background tasks, async endpoints, API design, and layered architecture.

questions.prompt: Where should HTTP path and method mapping live?
questions.explanation: Routers map HTTP requests to endpoint functions. They should stay thin and delegate business work.

concept_panel.title: FastAPI Routing
concept_panel.explanation: Routers map HTTP requests to endpoint functions. They should stay thin and delegate business work.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you understand FastAPI request organization.

questions.prompt: A DB session must be replaceable in tests. What FastAPI feature helps?
questions.explanation: FastAPI dependencies provide request-scoped collaborators and can be overridden in tests.

concept_panel.title: Dependency Injection
concept_panel.explanation: FastAPI dependencies provide request-scoped collaborators and can be overridden in tests.
concept_panel.practical_example: Use Depends(get_db) for a request-scoped session.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you can build testable FastAPI APIs.

questions.prompt: Where should invalid request shapes fail?
questions.explanation: Pydantic validates types and constraints before business logic runs.

concept_panel.title: Pydantic Validation
concept_panel.explanation: Pydantic validates types and constraints before business logic runs.
concept_panel.practical_example: Reject a missing `email` field before user creation logic.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you use schemas as API boundaries.

questions.explanation: Middleware wraps requests for concerns like CORS, logging, timing, auth context, and error envelopes.

concept_panel.title: Middleware
concept_panel.explanation: Middleware wraps requests for concerns like CORS, logging, timing, auth context, and error envelopes.
concept_panel.practical_example: Add request ID logging in middleware.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you understand request pipeline hooks.

questions.prompt: What should a JWT-protected endpoint verify?
questions.explanation: JWT authentication must verify the token and map trusted claims to an identity/authorization decision.

concept_panel.title: JWT Authentication
concept_panel.explanation: JWT authentication must verify the token and map trusted claims to an identity/authorization decision.
concept_panel.practical_example: Reject expired bearer tokens before accessing organization data.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you understand stateless API auth risks.

questions.prompt: When is a FastAPI background task appropriate?
questions.explanation: Background tasks fit follow-up work that does not need to block the response. Heavy jobs usually deserve workers/queues.

concept_panel.title: Background Tasks
concept_panel.explanation: Background tasks fit follow-up work that does not need to block the response. Heavy jobs usually deserve workers/queues.
concept_panel.practical_example: Send a notification after returning a successful response.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you can separate request latency from follow-up work.

questions.prompt: When does `async def` help in FastAPI?
questions.explanation: Async endpoints help when work spends time waiting on I/O. CPU-heavy work needs workers or processes.

concept_panel.title: Async Endpoints
concept_panel.explanation: Async endpoints help when work spends time waiting on I/O. CPU-heavy work needs workers or processes.
concept_panel.practical_example: Await an HTTP integration call without blocking the event loop.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you understand async FastAPI correctly.

questions.prompt: What should API error handling produce?
options: Consistent status codes and response shape
questions.answer: Consistent status codes and response shape
questions.explanation: Clients need predictable errors. Internal details should be logged, not leaked.

concept_panel.title: Error Handling
concept_panel.explanation: Clients need predictable errors. Internal details should be logged, not leaked.
concept_panel.practical_example: Return 404 for missing resource and 422 for validation failure.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you design reliable API contracts.

options: To bound response size and latency
questions.answer: To bound response size and latency
questions.explanation: Pagination and filtering keep APIs efficient and usable as data grows.

concept_panel.title: Pagination and Filtering
concept_panel.explanation: Pagination and filtering keep APIs efficient and usable as data grows.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you understand scalable API access patterns.

questions.prompt: What protects clients from breaking API changes?
questions.explanation: API versioning and compatibility policies let clients migrate safely.

concept_panel.title: Versioning
concept_panel.explanation: API versioning and compatibility policies let clients migrate safely.
concept_panel.practical_example: Add /v2 or optional fields instead of breaking /v1.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you manage API evolution.

options: To keep business logic out of route handlers
questions.answer: To keep business logic out of route handlers
questions.explanation: Services make business logic reusable and testable outside HTTP concerns.

concept_panel.title: Service Layer
concept_panel.explanation: Services make business logic reusable and testable outside HTTP concerns.
concept_panel.practical_example: DashboardService builds KPI widgets after route validation.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you can structure backend code beyond endpoints.

questions.prompt: What is the repository pattern for?
options: Isolating persistence behind a focused interface
questions.answer: Isolating persistence behind a focused interface
questions.explanation: Repositories isolate database access; DTOs/schemas define transfer boundaries.

concept_panel.title: Repository Pattern and DTOs
concept_panel.explanation: Repositories isolate database access; DTOs/schemas define transfer boundaries.
concept_panel.practical_example: ForecastRepository can hide SQL while service code asks for forecast history.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you understand layered backend architecture.

coding_challenges.title: EPAM FastAPI Architecture status classifier
coding_challenges.instructions: Implement classify_status_code(code: int) -> str. Return success for 200-299, redirect for 300-399, client_error for 400-499, server_error for 500-599, and unknown otherwise.
coding_challenges.explanation: The challenge reinforces deterministic branching, status-code categories, and local test execution.
